core_problem_solved: To provide a very lightweight, simple, and dependency-free toolkit for encoding and decoding JSON text in Java.
key_features: Parsing JSON text into standard Java objects (Map, List, etc.)
Serializing Java collections into JSON text
Minimal JAR size with zero external dependencies
era_and_niche: An early, minimalist JSON library popular in environments where a small footprint and zero dependencies were critical, such as early Android development or resource-constrained applets.
reason_for_obsolescence: This specific artifact is **obsolete** and is no longer maintained as it was hosted on the archived Google Code platform. The project has been continued by a community fork, **`com.github.cliftonlabs:json-simple`**. Even the modern fork is a niche library, as most applications prefer the feature-rich industry standards, **Jackson** and **Gson**.
